description: Get frequently ordered products by analysing order history. Fetches all fulfillments, expands each order's items, counts per product, and returns products ordered at least min_order_count times. Returns product_name, product_id, order_count, last_ordered_date. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

min_order_count.description: Minimum number of orders a product must appear in (default 3)

name: ah_get_frequent_items
title: Albert Heijn: Frequently Ordered Items
